name: page-edits
description: Apply the edits people make by highlighting text on a running Vite site: /page-edits watches the site's inbox and hands each new note to the session.

receiver.title: Receiver command
receiver.description: The command that runs page-edits' receiver. The default uses the site's own page-edits package; a site that loads page-edits from elsewhere names that copy, for example node /path/to/page-edits/cli.mjs.
